rationale: The workflow already implements cancellation of superseded/in-progress runs via `concurrency` with `cancel-in-progress: true` keyed by workflow and ref, which covers the P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE optimization. The only other fitting pattern, P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout), is not safely applicable here: its measured evidence adds 5-minute job timeouts, but Xcode/Swift test jobs on macOS runners commonly exceed that limit, and the repository CI history contains only one short successful run (~2.5 min) alongside several failures—insufficient representative successful-duration history to derive a safe timeout (P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT precondition unmet). Applying an unsupported timeout risks failing valid slow test runs, violating the requirement to preserve build and test coverage. No other pattern fits: there is no matrix (P-LIT-FAIL-FAST), no scheduled triggers (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE/P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE), no Bazel build (P-LIT-BAZEL-*), and no explicit dependency-install step with a cacheable lockfile (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE).
